subject: E-6414: totals mismatch on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using Tallyboard 1.9.6 on Windows 11 24H2. Whenever I export the report
since the weekend, the app shows "E-6414: totals do not match source".

I switched the system regional format to one that uses comma decimals. Since
then thousands and decimals look swapped in the totals.

What I tried so far: rebooting the router. No luck.

Thanks, Grace Okafor (Brightwater Clinics)
